[SWS_CM_11156] Sending a response for a get/set method call associated with
a field from the server side
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_CM_00220, RS_
CM_00221, FO_RS_Dds_00001, FO_RS_Dds_00008, FO_RS_Dds_-
00015
⌈
The binding implementation shall send a response upon the return of (1) a
SetHandler
in the case of a
Set()
operation; (2) a
GetHandler
in the case of
a
Get()
operation where a
GetHandler
has previously been registered; or (3) a
lookup operation
5
as a result of a
Get()
operation where no
GetHandler
was previ-
ously registered. This shall be performed.
⌋
The DDS serialization rules are defined in section 7.2.3.7.

00002

ization rules defined in section 7.4.3.5 of [23].
